subject: How to update SelectInput (in renderUI) dependent on SliderInput using actionButton

messages.author: 2b51e1bddc1b8433
messages.subject: How to update SelectInput (in renderUI) dependent on SliderInput using actionButton
parts:
I'm working on an app for conjoint analysis - client is seting the offers and he gets the results. Client can change the offerts remotly (simply using widgets) or import the CSV file with all values and set them up clicking **actionButton**. Problem is that some wigets are dependent from another (I'm using **renderUI** for those dependent widgets) and **update** functions in **observeEvent** are not working for them. 

I'll explain more precisely in this simple example:

Here I've got 2 offerts with 2 wigets each: 'cost' and 'type'. When cost is greater than 89.99  we can choose '1 SIM' or 'Family' offert type, otherwise there is only '1 SIM' type. When I'm using **actionButton** the **updateSliderInput** is changing the 'cost' value, but 'type' value is still the same. I was trying with two **observeEvent** with different priorities (one for 'cost', one for 'type') but it wasn't working too.

library(shiny)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  column(12,
         tabsetPanel(id="xyz",
                     tabPanel("Offers",
                              fluidRow(
                                column(2,
                                       sliderInput("cost1", label = "Cost",
                                                   min =39.99 , max =189.99 , value =49.99,step=0.01,post=" zł"),
                                       uiOutput("select1a")),
                                column(2,
                                       sliderInput("cost2", label = "Cost",
                                                   min =39.99 , max =189.99 , value =49.99,step=0.01,post=" zł"),
                                       uiOutput("select2a"))
                              )),
                     tabPanel("Import",
                              sidebarLayout(
                                sidebarPanel(
                                  fileInput('file1', 'Choose CSV', accept=c('text/csv','text/comma-separated-values,text/plain', '.csv')),
                                  checkboxInput('header', 'Heading', TRUE),
                                  radioButtons('sep', 'Sep',
                                               c(Comma=',',
                                                 Semicolon=';',
                                                 Tab='\t'),
                                               ','),
                                  radioButtons('dec','Dec',
                                               c(Comma=',',
                                                 Dot='.'),
                                               '.'),
                                  actionButton("goButton", "Update!")),
                                mainPanel(tableOutput('contents')))
                     ))
  )))

and

library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  output$select1a <- renderUI({
    if(input$cost1<89.99){choices1a <- list("1 SIM" = 1)} else {choices1a       <- list("1 SIM" = 1, "Family" = 2)}
    selectInput("type1", label = "Deal type", choices = choices1a,         selected = input$type1)})
  
  output$select2a <- renderUI({
    if(input$cost2<89.99){choices2a <- list("1 SIM" = 1)} else {choices2a <- list("1 SIM" = 1, "Family" = 2)}
    selectInput("type2", label = "Deal type", choices = choices2a, selected = input$type2)})
  
  output$contents<-renderTable({
    inFile<-input$file1
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    
    newData<-read.csv(inFile$datapath, header=input$header,        sep=input$sep,dec=input$dec)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$goButton,{
    inFile<-input$file1
    if (is.null(inFile)) {}
    else {
      newData<-read.csv(inFile$datapath, header=input$header, sep=input$sep,dec=input$dec)
      updateSliderInput(session,"cost1",value = newData[1,2])
      updateSliderInput(session,"cost2",value = newData[2,2])
      
      updateSelectInput(session,"type1",selected=nowedane[1,3])
      updateSelectInput(session,"type2",selected=nowedane[1,3])
      
      updateTabsetPanel(session, "xyz", selected = "Offers")
    }})
})

and CSV:
  
  OFFER;COST;TYPE
1;79.99;1
2;129.99;2

Any ideas?
